title: Giro della Bullaccia — route identity and geometry correction
researchMethod: Official destination itinerary cross-checked against the editor-supplied Waymarked Trails GeoJSON for relation 9483250 and GPX for trail 14 (relation 9483233). No field visit is claimed.
editorialSummary: The official identity is Giro della Bullaccia, starting and ending at Compatsch. The supplied relation 9483250 is a closed 6.76 km circuit. Trail 14 is a separate 3.53 km open line that intersects the circuit but continues south beyond Compatsch. Preserve it as proposed optional-route evidence; do not silently splice it into the main route.

blockers: Official distance is 8.4 km while the supplied closed geometry computes to 6.76 km.
Trail 14 requires a human decision about the exact detour entry, exit and user-facing purpose.
The official route direction and ordered trail-number changes still require cartographic verification.

sources.label: Editor-supplied Puflatschumrundung / Giro della Bullaccia GeoJSON

claims.label: Official route identity
claims.proposedValue: Use the canonical Italian name Giro della Bullaccia; start and finish at Compatsch.
claims.evidenceSummary: The official destination itinerary names the route and explicitly describes departure and return at Compatsch.
humanChecks: Preserve the existing internal slug until redirects and stored references can be migrated safely.

claims.label: Main circuit geometry
claims.proposedValue: Use the editor-supplied 1,008-point closed geometry from relation 9483250 as the candidate main circuit.
claims.evidenceSummary: The geometry closes exactly and computes to 6.76 km, but the official itinerary publishes 8.4 km.
claims.blocker: Resolve whether relation 9483250 is a shorter variant or whether the official metric uses a materially different line.
humanChecks: Compare the line with Engelsrast, Croce Filln, Panche delle Streghe and Croce Goller.
Orient the approved geometry from Compatsch in the official direction.

claims.label: Optional trail 14 route
claims.proposedValue: Retain trail 14 as an optional detour or approach overlay, not as a replacement for the main circuit.
claims.evidenceSummary: The 3.53 km open trail intersects the main circuit at several points and continues about 740 m south of the circuit start.
claims.blocker: The intended entry, exit and purpose of the detour are not established by the official itinerary.
humanChecks: Choose exact entry and exit coordinates.
Confirm whether the option is a detour, access route or numbered guidance segment.

claims.label: Official effort metrics
claims.proposedValue: The official itinerary reports 8.4 km, 413 m ascent and descent, 2 hours 36 minutes, and elevations from 1,852 m to 2,173 m.
claims.evidenceSummary: The figures are published together on the official route page.
humanChecks: Do not apply these figures to the 6.76 km geometry until the route mismatch is resolved.
